text:
Alex Kim: Heads up — Shoreline just sent over a CAIQ + a custom security questionnaire. They want answers and evidence for SOC2, encryption, and key management. POC kicks off next Mon; can security triage and take ownership? Link: https://files.redwood.internal/shoreline-caioq-2026.pdf
Priya Desai: Thanks — dropping in to read. Any NDA/redaction needed before we share artifacts? Also — are they planning on sending any live data to the POC?
Alex Kim: POC will run on Dedicated in us-west-2. Data will be pseudonymized but they require KMS/HSM for keys and console MFA. Timeline request: answers by EOD Wed (their procurement window).
Marco Li: Assigning to me for initial CAIQ mapping + gap list. If we need infra confirmation for HSM or KMS keyflow, @Jen Huang can provide deployment evidence and logs. I'll start with controls most likely to be flagged (key management, backups, isolation).
Jen Huang: Happy to help. We have an internal KMS/HSM integration runbook and a network isolation diagram for Dedicated. I can pull the SOC2 redacted copy if compliance approves. What exact artifacts do they want?
Alex Kim: They listed: SOC2 Type II report, encryption-at-rest details (algorithms + KMS), network isolation diagram for the POC VPC, and MFA enforcement for console/devops. Also they asked about our backup vendor and retention.
Priya Desai: OK. Marco — please create a CAIQ answers CSV with a column for "evidence needed" and mark high-risk items. I'll prepare the cover note and risk summary for sales. Suggest marking: HSM key custody, third-party backups, and pen test recency as high priority.
Marco Li: On it. Quick clarification: for "HSM-managed keys" we support BYOK via our KMS integration with customer-managed keys in cloud HSM. Evidence candidates: KMS runbook, example audit log, and diagram of key flow. I'll collate and add evidence links.
security-bot: Ticket created: RISK-2026 (shoreline-sig-intake). Owners: Marco Li, Priya Desai. Due: 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC.
Alex Kim: Great. Who will handle the redacted SOC2 upload to the secure portal? I can push to the customer once we have it.
Jen Huang: I can coordinate redaction with compliance. Send SOC2 to compliance@redwood.com and cc me; request PII redaction. I'll track and confirm when uploaded to the secure share.
Priya Desai: I'll do final review of the CAIQ answers + security cover note before delivery. Marco — please post the CSV here when ready so I can annotate.
Marco Li: Uploading a quick CSV snapshot now:
```csv
ControlID,Answer,Status,Evidence
CM-1,YES,Complete,https://kb.redwood.internal/kms-runbook
CM-2,NO,Needs mitigation,backup-vendor-contract (pending)
AC-3,YES,Complete,https://kb.redwood.internal/mfa-policy
```
Will populate full evidence links & attach diagrams by EOD.
Alex Kim: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — I'll update Shoreline on our ETA and that we've opened RISK-2026. Ping me immediately if any blockers appear.
